title: Holy Bible: Audio, AI & Plans
shortDescription: Free Bible: KJV, WEB, ASV & BBE with audio, AI answers, daily verse.study& plans
fullDescription:
Read, listen to and understand the Holy Bible — free, and beautifully designed like a real paper Bible.

📖 MULTIPLE BIBLE VERSIONS
• King James Version (KJV) — built in, works fully offline
• World English Bible (WEB) — modern, easy-to-read English
• American Standard Version (ASV) — classic, word-for-word accuracy
• Bible in Basic English (BBE) — simple English, ideal for new readers and English learners
• Switch versions instantly on any page; versions you open are saved for offline reading
• All 66 books of the Old and New Testament
• Highlight verses in 4 colors, bookmark and share
• Adjustable text size, day and night (dark) mode

🎧 AUDIO BIBLE
• Listen to any chapter read aloud
• Choose your narrator: Classic, Deep, Gentle, Storyteller and more
• Adjustable reading speed

✨ ASK THE BIBLE (AI)
• Ask any question: "What does Jeremiah 29:11 mean?"
• Explanations of verses, books and Bible characters
• Every answer quotes real Scripture with references
• Help for anxiety, fear, grief, forgiveness, marriage and more

🎤 SERMON WRITER
• Create full sermons and Bible study outlines in seconds
• Topical, expository or evangelistic styles
• Illustrations, application, prayer and discussion questions

📅 BIBLE READING PLANS
• 34 plans: Bible in a Year, New Testament in 90 Days, Psalms, Proverbs, Gospel of John and topics like peace, hope and prayer
• Create your own reading plan
• Track progress and keep your daily streak

🔔 VERSE OF THE DAY & DAILY REMINDER
• A new Bible verse every day
• Gentle daily reminder to read God's Word

Perfect for daily devotions, Bible study, church, prayer and sermon preparation. Whether you are new to faith or have read the Scriptures for years, this Holy Bible app helps you grow closer to God every day.

Download the free Holy Bible app now and start reading today!
